## Pre-call Resources
- [Ropsten Merge Announcement](https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/05/30/ropsten-merge-announcement/)
- [Ropsten TTD Announcement](https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/06/03/ropsten-merge-ttd/)
- [How The Merge Impacts Ethereum’s Application Layer](https://blog.ethereum.org/2021/11/29/how-the-merge-impacts-app-layer/)
- [AllCoreDevs Update 007 ⛓](https://hackmd.io/@timbeiko/acd/https%3A%2F%2Ftim.mirror.xyz%2FsR23jU02we6zXRgsF_oTUkttL83S3vyn05vJWnnp-Lc) - details about post merge Execution and Consensus client architectures
- [Mega Merge Resource List 🐼](https://notes.ethereum.org/Moiv99h9QTmI-imPL8pvQg?view)

## Discussion
- [Ropsten TTD override](https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/06/03/ropsten-merge-ttd/)
- [post-Merge testnets](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/og-council-post-merge-testnets/9034)
- Ropsten Merge projected for June 8
- block times go from ~13s to exactly 12s. may impact lending protocols and how they calculate annual rates (use timestamps)
- tx fees go to validator address on the Execution layer: [see here](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/specification.md#payloadattributesv1)
- Validators need to run both Execution and Consensus clients - and diversity matters for both (non-geth for EL, non-prysm for CL): [guides here](https://clientdiversity.org/#switch)
